items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: And he played most with this man... Jimmy Noon. He played most with Jimmy Noon.

ctx.x: And he played most with this man, played Clannett, what's his name, Dyer, when he was going to California? Jimmy Noon.
He played most with Jimmy Noon. Hilaire. Yeah. Yeah, the man played a nice band there, but he didn't get off either.
